title: Motus checkpoint v1
description: One sealed window of a writer's chain: the Merkle root over its commitments, the range it covers, and the link to the checkpoint before it. ADR-021 decision 2. A checkpoint that has not left the operator's machine proves nothing to a third party — 'checkpointed' means externally anchored, never merely written (ADR-020).

window_root.description: The Merkle root over this window's leaves. An odd node is promoted, never duplicated: duplication makes a tree of n and a tree of n+1 whose last leaf repeats produce one root.

previous.description: The digest of checkpoint index-1, or null at index 0. Present-and-null is the statement 'this is the first'; the field is never omitted, so a missing link cannot pass as a first checkpoint.
